entries.title: Proverbs 3:1
segments: ¶My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:2
segments: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee. {long...: Heb. years of life}

words.text: to thee. {long...: Heb. years of life}

entries.title: Proverbs 3:3
segments: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:4
segments: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man. {good...: or, good success}

entries.title: Proverbs 3:5
segments: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:6
segments: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:7
segments: ¶Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:8
segments: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones. {health: Heb. medicine} {marrow: Heb. watering, or, moistening}

words.text: . {health: Heb. medicine} {marrow: Heb. watering, or, moistening}

entries.title: Proverbs 3:9
segments: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:10
segments: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:11
segments: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:12
segments: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son [in whom] he delighteth.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:13
segments: ¶Happy [is] the man [that] findeth wisdom, and the man [that] getteth understanding. {that getteth...: Heb. that draweth out understanding}

words.text: . {that getteth...: Heb. that draweth out understanding}

entries.title: Proverbs 3:14
segments: For the merchandise of it [is] better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:15
segments: She [is] more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

words.text: : and all the things thou canst desire

entries.title: Proverbs 3:16
segments: Length of days [is] in her right hand; [and] in her left hand riches and honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:17
segments: Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, and all her paths [are] peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:18
segments: She [is] a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy [is every one] that retaineth her.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:19
segments: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens. {established: or, prepared}

entries.title: Proverbs 3:20
segments: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:21
segments: ¶My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:22
segments: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:23
segments: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:24
segments: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:25
segments: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:26
segments: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:27
segments: ¶Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do [it]. {them...: Heb. the owners thereof}

words.text: from them to whom it is due
, when it is in the power

entries.title: Proverbs 3:28
segments: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:29
segments: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee. {Devise...: or, Practise no evil}

words.text: by thee. {Devise...: or, Practise no evil}

entries.title: Proverbs 3:30
segments: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:31
segments: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways. {the oppressor: Heb. a man of violence}

words.text: . {the oppressor: Heb. a man of violence}

entries.title: Proverbs 3:32
segments: For the froward [is] abomination to the LORD: but his secret [is] with the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:33
segments: The curse of the LORD [is] in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:34
segments: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:35
segments: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools. {shall be...: Heb. exalteth the fools}
